Posted 'Swoop' on this Dark list dested Flare-S Racing Swoop (Air-2 Racing Swoop is Light); 'EPP IG-88' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Cloud City East Platform' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Fett in Slave 1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Visage of the Emporer' Visage Of The Emperor; 'Intruder Missle' Intruder Missile.
Battle Order and Come Here You Big Coward are the older Effects (no Defensive Shields in November 1999). His later [[Scott Lingrell Anktopot 2000]] is a different list.
